title: kid text forms
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 12.6 The certificate; GDHCN Trustlists (DID), Example DID documents. QR Code Generation, 12.6 The certificate: “The kid for both is WHM+BYqqZiE= (hex 58733e058aaa6621).”.

statements.label: kid text forms
statements.requirement: Kid SHALL convert to and from hex, standard base64 and URL-safe base64. Trust-list matching SHALL compare the kid bytes, not their text form.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-KID-003 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-KID-003 a kid reads and writes as standard and URL-safe base64` (TrustListTest.kt)).
